title: CodeAtlas System Schema
description: Schema defining a cross-cutting architectural system that supports one or more features, flows, or other systems.

description.description: Semantic description of what this system provides or enables architecturally.

technical_role.description: Technical purpose of the system (e.g., 'Manages cached poster metadata and revalidation lifecycle').

semantic_role.description: Human-facing purpose of the system (e.g., 'Ensures saved artwork is reliably available offline or across screens).

primary_files.description: Core files that implement or own this system.

supporting_files.description: Auxiliary files that help implement this system without owning it.

supported_features.description: Feature IDs that this system directly enables.

related_systems.description: IDs of other systems that interact with or depend on this system.

external_dependencies.description: External libraries, APIs, services, or infrastructure required by this system.

aliases.description: Natural-language synonyms or common alternative names for this system.

keywords.description: Core vocabulary tokens describing this system.

evidence.description: Optional structured provenance supporting this system definition.

file.description: Repository-relative file path referenced by this evidence.

symbol.description: Relevant exported symbol or identifier, when available.

lines.description: Optional line range; fields may be omitted if line numbers are unknown or stale.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of why this evidence supports the mapping.

confidence.description: Confidence in the accuracy and completeness of this system definition.

notes.description: Observations, caveats, or uncertainties about the system scope.
